cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: sinh x = (eˣ - e⁻ˣ)/2, cosh x = (eˣ + e⁻ˣ)/2, tanh x = sinh x/cosh x

cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: Identities: cosh^2x - sinh^2x = 1, 1 - tanh^2x = sech^2x, sinh 2x = 2 sinh x cosh x, cosh 2x = cosh^2x + sinh^2x

cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: Derivatives: d/dx(sinh x) = cosh x, d/dx(cosh x) = sinh x, d/dx(tanh x) = sech^2x

cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: Integrals: ∫sinh x dx = cosh x + C, ∫cosh x dx = sinh x + C, ∫sech^2x dx = tanh x + C

cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: Inverse functions: arsinh x = ln(x + sqrt(x^2+1)), arcosh x = ln(x + sqrt(x^2-1)) (x>=1), artanh x = ½ ln((1+x)/(1-x)) (|x|<1)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Hyperbolic Functions
cards.back: Osborn's rule: trig identity -> hyperbolic by changing sign of sin^2 terms
